input.body:
## Summary

Restore enemy constructor values and the source suggestion lifecycle through the current controls.

```text
new →20 life /20 reward /2 speed, suggestions enabled
open/action → panel calculation
save → recompute with source save rounding
number edit → manual values persist
import → compare preceding counters, retain manual mode
```

Keep the suggestion flag transient. This is the first values/state slice of original491b002; the authored panel, checkbox/confirmation and sliders follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** New enemies start1/1/1, suggestions clamp empty life to1, and saved values can stay stale after geometry changes.
  **After:** Source defaults, phase-specific arithmetic and enabled save recomputation retain the correct values; valid manual edits select manual mode through the existing number inputs.
- ActionScript and exported pcode agree on the critical life calculation: save rounds before class multiplication; panel rounds afterwards; import comparison uses the unrounded product. Pcode2166/2169,10782/10783 and18246/18247 independently verify that ordering.
- Retain reward minimum/capped discount and speed minimum/hundredth floor, including0.19 binary Number behavior. Manual limits do not clamp this independent calculation.
- Formatting, TypeScript,501 rule tests (6,113 assertions), production build and all six native/mock values, placement and saved-copy/medal browser cases pass in1.7 minutes, without skips. Strengthened manual-mode cases pass35.4s.
- Browser evidence: initial20/20/2; empty panel0/1/3; changed geometry with stale0 readout saves1/1/3; re-enabled suggestions then manual333/77/2.75 survives reopening/save. Existing placement geometry, animation, cancellation and avatar saving remain verified. Unit tests cover three rounding orders and the previous-counter import latch.
- The current number-input behavior is a compatibility bridge until authored controls land. Full manual text/slider rules, confirmation, input timing and source-screen comparison remain pending. No artwork, generated metadata, schema, drag or history changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the prior values and suggestion behavior. Existing saved-design format is unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Enemy draft values and save behavior change; avatar saving remains guarded separately.

## Summary

Restore enemy constructor values and the source suggestion lifecycle through the current controls.

```text
new →20 life /20 reward /2 speed, suggestions enabled
open/action → panel calculation
save → recompute with source save rounding
number edit → manual values persist
import → compare preceding counters, retain manual mode
```

Keep the suggestion flag transient. This is the first values/state slice of original491b002; the authored panel, checkbox/confirmation and sliders follow separately.

## Evidence

- **Before:** New enemies start1/1/1, suggestions clamp empty life to1, and saved values can stay stale after geometry changes.
  **After:** Source defaults, phase-specific arithmetic and enabled save recomputation retain the correct values; valid manual edits select manual mode through the existing number inputs.
- ActionScript and exported pcode agree on the critical life calculation: save rounds before class multiplication; panel rounds afterwards; import comparison uses the unrounded product. Pcode2166/2169,10782/10783 and18246/18247 independently verify that ordering.
- Retain reward minimum/capped discount and speed minimum/hundredth floor, including0.19 binary Number behavior. Manual limits do not clamp this independent calculation.
- Formatting, TypeScript,501 rule tests (6,113 assertions), production build and all six native/mock values, placement and saved-copy/medal browser cases pass in1.7 minutes, without skips. Strengthened manual-mode cases pass35.4s.
- Browser evidence: initial20/20/2; empty panel0/1/3; changed geometry with stale0 readout saves1/1/3; re-enabled suggestions then manual333/77/2.75 survives reopening/save. Existing placement geometry, animation, cancellation and avatar saving remain verified. Unit tests cover three rounding orders and the previous-counter import latch.
- The current number-input behavior is a compatibility bridge until authored controls land. Full manual text/slider rules, confirmation, input timing and source-screen comparison remain pending. No artwork, generated metadata, schema, drag or history changes.

Revert restores the prior values and suggestion behavior. Existing saved-design format is unchanged.

Enemy draft values and save behavior change; avatar saving remains guarded separately.
